title: Agent usage
description: Tokens and cost of the agents Thurbox launches, normalised across agents.

panels.title: Cost by agent
panels.description: USD over the range, as each agent reports it. Only Claude Code exports a cost: the other agents show under Agent coverage, never as an estimate.

panels.title: Tokens by agent
panels.description: Every agent on one scale: uncached input, cache reads, cache writes and output, normalised from each agent's own token types (TOKEN_CLASSES in tools/dashboards.py).
